$comment: Museum Cinema programme. Local entries list only real, locally shipped media, each hash-checked by tests/cinema.test.ts. YouTube entries are an explicit online exception (docs/MUSEUM_CINEMA_YOUTUBE_2026-11-21.md): add them with the cinema's Add video panel (dev save route) or by importing an exported list. The room and the player do not change.

films.title: The Full Weasel · Background loop 1
films.description: A green-lit disco ball over a wooden room, a "Happy Birthday Nana Cheese" banner and floating flecks of light.
films.context: One of the animated background loops The Full Weasel plays behind its rhythm game ("Primary animated background loop" in the game's asset manifest). Shown here on its own, exactly as shipped.
films.captionsNote: No captions: the clip has no soundtrack and no speech.
